execution: Real projen API and CLI in disposable /tmp repositories. npm package publication/consumption uses an offline local cache. Cloud resources and agent runners are absent.
post_synthesis: Disabled: no package installation, lock regeneration or agent execution is hidden inside synthesis.

cases.name: native-adopt-restore
cases.requirement: Restore the original adopted config after removing its component
cases.observed: A preexisting file is overwritten, then deleted when its managed component is absent; original bytes are not restored.

cases.name: native-edited-file-removal
cases.requirement: Refuse to delete a managed file edited by hand
cases.observed: Orphan cleanup removes the whole previously tracked file despite the manual addition.

cases.name: native-managed-drift
cases.requirement: Report a manual change to managed output before overwriting it
cases.observed: Synthesis regenerates edited output without an ownership-hash diagnostic.

cases.name: native-sample-file
cases.requirement: Seed files without claiming future edits
cases.observed: SampleFile preserves existing files; it cannot later maintain selected keys.

cases.name: native-duplicate-writer
cases.requirement: Reject two components writing the same path
cases.observed: There is already a file under config.json

cases.name: native-readonly-false-removal
cases.requirement: Remove a contribution when its editable file component is absent
cases.observed: Editable files are omitted from the current cleanup manifest and remain after component removal.

cases.name: native-cross-file-rollback
cases.requirement: Restore the before state if a later file synthesis fails
cases.observed: Earlier file writes remain after a later synthesis failure.

cases.name: native-future-attachment
cases.requirement: Support declaration before attachment to a project
cases.observed: FutureComponent.attach provides a native deferred attachment mechanism.

cases.name: composition
cases.requirement: Connect independent exports to one writer
cases.observed: Five small components compose through ordinary objects and projen file primitives.
